name: gate_colossus_declined_stays_in_the_graveyard
notes: M5 mapper. Printed: 'Whenever a Gate you control enters, you may put this card from your graveyard on top of your library.' Gate Colossus is in seat 0's graveyard; seat 0 plays Azorius Guildgate and declines ('skip'): the Colossus stays in the graveyard and the library is untouched.
